i'm **errbufferoverfl** (they/them). welcome to my webhouse.

work only takes up 23.81% of my time so instead of making it my whole personality, i fill the rest with:

* making zines about things like who _really_ picks pantone’s colour of the year, the politics of horror movies, and why hot chips deserve more respect
* drawing, painting, and occasionally battling linoleum blocks like they personally wronged me
* reading books i pretend are research (but really just deeply niche interests)
* writing strongly-worded submissions to government consultations
* staring at my plants and wondering if they’re judging me
* staring at my plants and judging them like they judge me
* building things (like oauth servers or random scripts) i may or may not finish

**the other 23.81% of my time?**

by day, i’m a security engineer focused on security partnerships, working within an app-based browser ecosystem. i mostly write python (because i believe in using the right tool for the job—and sometimes the fun one). I’ve got a bit of a knack for federated identity (if I do say so myself), and  i
like building little tools that either solve problems or create entirely new ones.

depends on the day.

**what's your favourite...?**

* **thing to do when I'm supposed to be productive?**
tag books on libby as "want to read" knowing i never will

* **kitchen utensil with no practical purpose in my life?**
my silicone rabbit tea infuser, because i never make just one cup of tea

* **thing to dramatically sigh about?**
my computer charger being just out of reach

* **way to assert dominance over inanimate objects?**
apologising when i bump into them

* **completely unnecessary step in my routine?**
putting five extra pillows on my bed
